name: Oil (Brent)
summary: Brent rebounds to about $97 from a two-month low; Alert holds while Hormuz stays largely shut
state: Brent rebounded on 5 Nov to about $97 from a two-month low as uncertainty over the Iran war lingered (The National), a price in the Watch band and down 7% in a month. Alert is kept on the physical outage: Hormuz remains largely shut and more tankers were hit in the strait on 5 Nov (US News).
for_you: Fuel and heating costs stay exposed to Gulf supply news; prices can swing sharply on reports from the talks.
rubric_hit: Major physical outage (Hormuz largely shut) = Alert; Brent $97 alone = Watch
basis_detail: raised above the data floor on reported events

sources.title: The National — Oil rebounds from two-month low
US News — Tankers hit in Hormuz as Iran keeps up pressure after US vote

why: Oil feeds inflation, transport and household budgets; price spikes have preceded most post-war recessions.
drivers: OPEC+ output, Middle East supply risk, sanctions, demand, inventories, shipping disruption.

rubric.alert: Brent > $110, or 1-month change > +30%, or a major physical supply outage (> 2 mb/d).
